name: Swire Coca-Cola USA - Salt Lake City Production Plant, UT

fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied '5405 W 1730 S, Salt Lake City' and coords 40.732482,-112.02077. That address is NOT in Swire Coca-Cola's official Utah facility list (Draper HQ 12634 S 265 W, West Valley City 2269 S 3270 W, Ogden, Logan, Price, Richfield) and the building at the roster coords is an office-style building with a barrier-gate driveway and a 'West 1730 South' monument sign - no Coca-Cola branding. The roster coordinates appear to be wrong.
fieldNotes.resolvedAddress: The confirmed Swire Coca-Cola Salt Lake City production/manufacturing plant is at 2269 S 3270 W, West Valley City, UT 84119 (phone 801-816-5300; multiple directories incl. Yelp and a Waze 'Swire Coca-Cola truck staging area' entry confirm this). This is the plant that won a 2023 environmental award and cut water use 19% in 2022.
fieldNotes.coords: Best-estimate ~40.7287,-111.9712, a large warehouse-with-docks complex in the 3270 W industrial corridor of West Valley City. NOT positively confirmed - the corridor is a dense multi-tenant logistics park. One nearby building was observed handling Gatorade (a competitor brand) and others show third-party logistics tenants (UPS, PDIIKE Distribution Logistics), so the exact Swire Coca-Cola building footprint could not be unambiguously isolated in satellite/Street View imagery. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Estimated box around the candidate warehouse complex - not a confirmed parcel.
fieldNotes.classification: All physical-layout flags left false/null because the exact Swire Coca-Cola building could not be confirmed; the truck gate, docks, guard booth and yard could not be reliably attributed to the correct facility.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - West Valley City industrial corridor within the Salt Lake City metro.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Correct the roster address to 2269 S 3270 W, West Valley City, UT 84119 and re-audit once the exact Swire Coca-Cola building footprint is confirmed (e.g. via a precise geocode or a Coca-Cola sign in updated imagery).
